editorial.blurb: Happy Lamb Hot Pot delivers an interactive, warming communal feast where you simmer fresh meats, vegetables, and noodles in flavorful broths right at your table.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit the weekday lunch special (11:30am-4pm, Mon-Fri) for AYCE hot pot around $33 after tip, and try the half-and-half broth pairing original and spicy for the best flavor range.
